Approvals needed from Redwood:
- Legal (contract redlines + SOW sign-off): Marissa (I copied)
- Security (data handling + retention): Camila (copied)
- Finance (billing terms + PO cadence): Lauren (copied)

Our proposed gating ritual (short version):
1) Internal review window (1 business day for each team) — Marissa/Camila/Finance to confirm by EOD Thu 8/6.
2) Exec acceptance call (15 min) — Fri 8/7 at 10:00 PT (Vivek + Sophie + Marissa + Camila).
3) DocuSign envelope generated Fri 8/7 afternoon; sigs collected Fri 8/7–Mon 8/10 (we can push for Friday in-loop).
4) Operational cooling week 8/10–8/16 (your request) — start playbook and provisioning during that week; kickoff 8/16.

Constraints / notes:
- Security still needs to validate the retentions appendix we added; if there are material changes that will shift the clock.
- We can enable a "soft start" (limited capacity access for a selected pilot team) earlier if Acme needs immediate access before full provisioning; that requires a quick addendum to the SOW.

Next steps for this thread:
- Marissa: redline acceptance or calls out by EOD Thu 8/6.
- Camila: confirm security evidence packet (SOC2 snapshot + network diagram) by Thu 8/6.
- Lauren: confirm invoice/PO path and if finance needs a 14-day net or net-30 temporary term.
- Sophie/Michael: confirm whether Acme will accept Friday e-sign or needs to hold until Monday.

I'll schedule the 15-min exec call for Fri 8/7 10:00 PT and share a calendar invite after internal green-lit approvals.

— Vivek
